items.title: Automated Valuation Models (AVMs) for NYC
items.description: New York's real estate valuation is notoriously complex — co-ops with income restrictions, condos with unique amenity profiles, rent-stabilized buildings with income capitalization constraints, and commercial assets with cap rate compression driven by global capital flows. Standard AVM approaches designed for homogeneous suburban markets systematically fail on NYC's heterogeneous asset universe. ClickMasters builds NYC-calibrated AVMs incorporating: ACRIS transaction data with co-op vs. condo vs. townhouse classification; PLUTO building data (FAR, zoning, construction year, units); DOF property tax assessment history; rent stabilization data from DHCR registration records; neighborhood pricing gradient models at block-face resolution. Cost: $55,000–$140,000 | Timeline: 14–24 weeks.
items.label: AVM

items.title: Commercial Real Estate Intelligence
items.description: NYC CRE — office, retail, multifamily, industrial, and mixed-use — requires AI that goes beyond generic commercial real estate analytics: lease analytics (NLP extracting structured data from lease abstracts — term, rent, escalations, TI, options, co-tenancy, exclusives — from the large volumes of commercial lease documentation); investment analytics (ML predicting CRE asset performance, cap rate compression/expansion, and tenant credit risk); distress prediction (ML identifying CRE assets at elevated distress risk from loan maturity, refinancing risk, occupancy trends, and borrower financial signals — particularly relevant in NYC's post-pandemic office market). Cost: $50,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks.
items.label: CRE Intelligence

items.title: PropTech Product AI
items.description: New York's PropTech startup ecosystem — StreetEasy (Zillow), Compass, VTS, Building Engines, and dozens of Series A/B PropTech companies building AI-powered real estate software products. ClickMasters builds the AI capabilities that define PropTech products: AI-powered listing recommendation and search ranking; predictive maintenance and building systems intelligence for property management platforms; tenant behavior analytics and renewal propensity prediction for multifamily platforms; natural language lease parsing for lease management software. Cost: $40,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 12–24 weeks.
items.label: PropTech
